content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are a B2B software company building a multi-tenant Laravel platform for industrial sites. We are hiring a hands-on Head of Engineering and need an experienced engineer to run the technical interviews and give us a written, independent assessment of each candidate. You interview; we make the hiring decision.

Scope

Four to five candidate interviews over two to three weeks, scheduled by us. Each interview is 90 minutes in two parts:
- Part 1 (45 min): technical depth. Laravel and PHP in production, PostgreSQL, Inertia.js with Vue 3, multi-tenant design, security practice. Questions probe real decisions they made, not textbook answers.
- Part 2 (45 min): live problem. You bring one realistic scenario (taking over an unfamiliar Laravel codebase, a data model issue, a tenant isolation flaw) and the candidate works through it with you, with their AI coding tools if they use them.

Within 24 hours of each interview, a written assessment of one page scored 1 to 5 on five criteria, with evidence for each score:
1. Laravel and PHP depth in production
2. Data modelling, PostgreSQL and multi-tenant design
3. Codebase takeover and stabilisation judgement
4. Security practice
5. Use of AI coding tools and the judgement to review what they produce
Plus a clear recommendation: hire, hire as senior engineer not lead, or no.

One 30-minute call with us after the batch to compare candidates.

You

- 8+ years in software engineering, with Laravel in production in the last three years
Have hired or interviewed senior engineers before and can tell a strong résumé from a strong engineer
- Comfortable interviewing in English over video; candidates are mainly in Egypt and Jordan, interviews fall Sunday to Thursday
- Not affiliated with any candidate

Terms

- Fixed price per interview including the written assessment (State your price per interview in your proposal).
- Start within one week. Signed NDA.

To be considered, send: your Laravel experience in two lines, one example of a senior hire you assessed and what you looked for, and your price per interview.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: Senior Laravel Engineer for Technical Interviews

screening_questions:
<untrusted_participant_content>
Describe one senior Laravel engineer you interviewed who looked strong on paper and you recommended against. What did you ask, and what in the answer told you?
</untrusted_participant_content>

<untrusted_participant_content>
In five lines or fewer, write the live problem you would put to a candidate to test whether they can take over an unfamiliar multi-tenant Laravel codebase without re-platforming it.
</untrusted_participant_content>
